design.contrast: repeated class/slot code versus unique-member/name or ordinal interpretations
design.falsifier: If a fixed complete form maps one-to-one to a named member or stable ordinal after owner masking, or if same-form occurrences have no shared slot/class property, the class-code hypothesis fails.
design.mechanism: A complete recurring form is a class/slot/system-entry code whose reference is to an organised position or class, not to one named object.
design.prediction: Across held panels, same-form reuse should coincide with shared slot/class properties and tolerate different members; masked-owner context should retain slot/class prediction but not recover one unique owner.
design.related: Near GDT793/GDT794 and existing IDEA026 panel-local reference; retained as a raw proposal with a different falsifier focused on cross-member class invariance, not rerunning the prior ordinal or owner screen.
